title: Overlay snapshot stays in sync after right-now regen
description:
As a Kanbus user I want kbs now to show generated right-now summaries even when an overlay snapshot is newer than the canonical issue file.

Related bug: kbs-ec5db2.

Feature: Right now summary regeneration on mutation

  Scenario: Regenerating a right now summary updates a newer overlay snapshot
    Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
    And mock AI is enabled
    And an issue exists
    And a newer overlay snapshot for that issue has no right now summary
    When I update the issue
    Then listing that issue should show the mock right now summary
right_now_summary: Regenerated right-now summaries now appear in newer overlay snapshots after an issue update.
